name: Dissolve by decree
description:
50% immunity to status effects.
Attacks from this unit can't be dodged, and have 70% chance of inflicting each of the following statuses for 3 turns: POISON, SILENCE, FREEZE, ABLAZE, STUN.

POISON: damage reduced by 20%
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn.
ABLAZE: takes 5% max hp as magic damage at the start of its turn
STUN: the unit skips its turn
